excluded_candidates.reason_excluded: Migration not possible without design phase. withCanonicalEnforcement wrapper must first be extended to support workspace membership enforcement. Requires architecture decision on how workspace scoping integrates with canonical wrapper.
Custom role resolution (resolveServerRole) requires separate design. Cannot use withCanonicalEnforcement directly. Requires decision on how custom roles integrate with capability-based auth.

audit_summary.explanation: No safe pilot candidates exist. Workspace enforcement requires wrapper design. Custom role resolution requires separate design. Both are architectural decisions.
